reconstruction.reason: The driver (schedlab/ompexec.py as locked) finished every measurement and closed runs.csv and task_trace.csv.gz, then raised TypeError while building manifest.json: execute() sets config_sha256 (instance config) and run_final() passed config_sha256 (locked config) again in extra_manifest. No manifest was written, post-run checks did not run, files were not sealed. Measurement files are unchanged; this manifest is written afterwards from recomputable values only.
reconstruction.method: reconstruct_manifest.py (copy in this directory); driver stdout: driver_stdout.log
reconstruction.deviation: Driver bug fixed after the run (extra keys renamed locked_config_*); the run used the locked driver, preserved byte-identically in execution_snapshot/.

lost_fields.host_start: host dict at start (cpu, cores, RAM, OS, pmset power string): held only in the crashed process
lost_fields.host_end: host dict at end, including the power state at the end of the run
lost_fields.power_at_launch_exact: exact pmset string seen by the driver; only the fact that its AC check passed is known
lost_fields.wall_time_s_exact: perf_counter total; the last progress line gives the time after the last instance
lost_fields.manifest_written_utc: time the original manifest would have been written

omp_wait_policy: libgomp default: OMP_WAIT_POLICY and GOMP_SPINCOUNT unset (threads spin, then sleep); unchanged from the pilot
power_at_launch: AC Power: the driver refuses to start otherwise (run_final checks pmset); the operator's pmset reading immediately before launch was "Now drawing from 'AC Power'"

host_at_reconstruction.power: Now drawing from 'AC Power' -InternalBattery-0 (id=35520611) 86%; AC attached; not charging present: true
host_at_reconstruction.note: measured now, not at the run; same machine

note: Measured seconds on the host. sim_makespan_tu is simulated (sim_tu) and only echoed for later comparison. Raw rows; derived metrics are computed separately.
